original_forecast.resolution_rule: Use ONLY the first official October 2026 BLS PRODUCER Price Index for final demand excluding FOODS, ENERGY AND TRADE SERVICES, seasonally adjusted one-month percent change at displayed one-decimal precision. First expected release Nov 13 at 08:30 EST; if delayed, first actual release. TRUE iff reported October monthly change >=+0.5%, else FALSE. If this specific figure omitted, remain PENDING until first actual official publication; do not infer, impute or substitute October consumer core/headline CPI, PPI less only food and energy, full PPI, yoy, later revisions or contemporary consensus. Freeze p=.44, point +0.4%, 80% [0.0%,0.9%], first September core-core PPI +0.5 and two-month first-release average +0.4 point benchmarks before any October PPI outcome. Score Brier/log loss, point MAE, interval hit/width and benchmark point errors separately. All original forecast content immutable.
rationale: October 2026 core CPI was +0.3% again, with slowing shelter and services, but headline +0.4 and prior producer pricing leave upstream inflation pressure unresolved; consumer and producer baskets are not interchangeable.

September first core-core PPI was +0.5% versus August +0.3%, yielding frozen two-month +0.4 point baseline; model also estimates +0.4, so no prospective claim of an advantage over this simple baseline.
This intermediate producer-price release tests an upstream-cost persistence channel for H003 versus rapid cooling compatible with H001, but cannot alone establish actual future consumer pass-through.

Judgmental p=.44 reflects uncertainty; it is not demonstrated calibration on a homogeneous target history. Existing weights H001 .39/H002 .10/H003 .39/H004 .12 remain unchanged; forecast adds a distinct target rather than duplicating today's CPI.
surprising_if: First-release October core-core PPI >=+1.0% m/m, above the upper nominal 80% interval.
First-release October core-core PPI <=-0.2% m/m, below the nominal lower interval.
original_forecast.source_timing_note: Created after independently committed November 10 Auditor resolution P000035 and post-resolution Skeptic. Future BLS November 13 observation cannot alter evidence cutoff/probability/point/interval/benchmark. No trading.

resolution.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Producer Price Indexes — October 2026, first release USDL 26-1687
resolution.audit_note: First BLS October 2026 PPI core-core +0.5% m/m at one-decimal precision equals/exceeds frozen >=+0.5% boundary. TRUE, p=.44, Brier .3136/log .820980552; point +.4 misses by .1pp, 80% [0,.9] covers. Frozen September no-change +.5 beats point, two-month +.4 ties; neutral p=.5 beats event Brier. Headline +.3 is a different construct. No later revision or post-outcome explanation changes original.
